The site was a disused freight depot until the city bought it two years ago. A regional development loan funded the work. No tenants have been chosen yet. Officials are 132 ------- that most stalls will be taken by produce sellers and food producers.

Application forms are available from the planning office. Stall rent covers use of the cold room. Forms returned after August 15 will be held for a second round. The hall opens on October 3, with the upper level following in November. 134 -------.
